stock_segments.discussion_summary: Tom Nash presents Bloom Energy as the stock with the most upside for 2026 due to its unique position solving AI data center power constraints. The company provides off-grid, 24/7 power through natural gas fuel cells that output 800 volts DC - exactly matching Nvidia's new Blackwell chip requirements. With the electrical grid requiring 7-10 years to upgrade to meet AI power demands, Bloom's drop-in solution represents the only viable immediate option. The company has validated its technology through a major deal with Oracle, where Larry Ellison invested through warrants at $113. While the stock is volatile with management execution risks and potential concerns about AI being a bubble, the asymmetric risk/reward profile (50% downside vs 7x upside) makes it compelling for long-term investors willing to dollar-cost average over a 5+ year horizon.
